cats.name: lmeow
cats.catName: Smudge, the white 'Woman Yelling at a Cat' cat, drawn as the lmeow cat
cats.whoIsTheCat: Smudge is a fluffy white rescue cat from Ottawa, Ontario, owned by Miranda Stillabower. In June 2018 she posted him glaring from his dinner-table chair behind a salad ('He no like vegetals'); in May 2019 the photo became the cat half of 'Woman Yelling at a Cat'. lmeow's logo is a cartoon of that face, though the project never names him.

virality.summary: Two internet stories meet here. The face is Smudge's: his June 2018 Tumblr photo drew 50,300 notes within a year, and on 1 May 2019 @MISSINGEGIRL paired it with a Real Housewives screenshot, creating 'Woman Yelling at a Cat', which won Meme of the Year at the 2020 Shorty Awards and put Smudge at the top of Time's 2020 ranking of online cats. The name is crypto-Twitter slang: 'lmeow' is 'lmao' said by a cat (the trader CL posted 'feviknight just said lmeow' in Nov 2022). The Ethereum token opened on Uniswap on 1 Nov 2022, days before FTX collapsed. On 8 Feb 2023 the trader GCR posted 'waiting for $LMEOW token that catalyzes a paradigm shift in meme investing away from dog tokens to cat tokens', which the community calls its prophecy. @lmeowcoineth still posts Woman-Yelling-at-a-Cat parodies.
virality.metrics: @MISSINGEGIRL's original meme post: 78,000+ retweets and 275,000+ likes in about three months (Wikipedia, citing The Daily Dot). Smudge: 1.4M Instagram followers (Time, Jan 2020). GCR's Feb 2023 post: 558.8K views as quoted by LMEOW fan sites (original post not retrieved). @GCRClassic: 393,390 followers. @lmeowcoineth: 4,406 followers, 5,583 posts (joined 2024-03-03). GeckoTerminal: 5,017 holders (top 10 hold 33.7%). CoinGecko watchlists: 2,951. Read 2026-09-25 21:50-22:02 UTC.

coin.endorsedByOwner: No. No source shows Smudge's owner, Miranda Stillabower, endorsing lmeow, and the project does not name Smudge. GCR's Feb 2023 post named the ticker, but it is not an endorsement of this contract.

cats.lore: Lmeow is how a cat laughs: crypto Twitter's cat-sized 'lmao'. This cat wears a famous face. Smudge, a fluffy white rescue from Ottawa, insists on his own chair at family dinners, and one night in 2018 he was photographed behind a plate of salad with a look of pure disdain. 'He no like vegetals,' said the caption. A year later the photo became half of 'Woman Yelling at a Cat', one of the best-loved memes of its decade. Lmeow keeps his squint and curled lip, the cat at the table who has heard enough.

cats.name: Leveraged Cat
cats.catName: Lever Cat, a fictional brown tabby-and-white trading-floor cat
cats.whoIsTheCat: Not a real cat: Leveraged Cat is the coin's own photorealistic mascot, a wide-eyed brown tabby-and-white cat pulling a lever in front of glowing trading screens. It was made for the coin's launch on StonkFun (Solana) on 7 Sep 2026; the artist is not named. 'Lever' puns on leverage: the coin is paired with Hylo's leveraged SOL token, xSOL.

virality.summary: No viral cat or original post; the Lever Cat's fame is inside Solana's StonkFun scene. StonkFun lets new coins trade against assets other than SOL, and Leveraged Cat chose xSOL, Hylo's leveraged SOL token, under the pitch 'Buy the cat, keep your SOL exposure'. It filled its StonkFun bonding curve in about 13 minutes on 7 Sep 2026 and moved to Raydium. The team also runs Leverminal, a trading terminal for Hylo-backed StonkFun coins that spends its platform fees buying LEVERCAT and burning it. The independent Stonk Board tracks it among the top 20 StonkFun reward coins.
virality.metrics: @LeverCatSol: 1,939 followers, 294 posts (joined 2026-09-07). Holders: 5,153 (GeckoTerminal, top 10 hold 22.9%); 5.1K, +149 in 7 days (The Stonk Board, 22:03 UTC). The Stonk Board: market-cap rank #17 of its top-100 StonkFun reward coins; $1.37M paid to holders in xSOL over the coin's life (at payout-token prices). StonkFun API: peak market cap $8.09M. Picture it at the controls: paw on the handle, mouth open in wonder, green and red candles glowing behind.

cats.name: MIU
cats.catName: MIU, a fictional white cartoon kitten from the Sui Network
cats.whoIsTheCat: Not a real cat: MIU is a cartoon white kitten with huge turquoise eyes, the mascot of a community meme coin on the Sui Network launched on 3 Dec 2024. The project calls it 'the playful cat bringing fun to the Sui Network'; its banner shows it underwater among bubbles, seaweed and small fish. The artist and team are anonymous.

virality.summary: No viral origin: MIU is an original community mascot that grew with the Sui meme scene rather than from one post. The coin launched on 3 December 2024, set up staking, a token creator and a token lock for Sui users, and keeps a community fund for campaigns on platforms such as Zealy and Galxe. Through 2025 it added exchange listings (MEXC, Toobit, BitMart, Biconomy, XT.com) and drew explainer articles from Phemex Academy (April 2025) and JrKripto; its fans call themselves the 'MIU Army'. Today most of its trading is on centralized exchanges.

GeckoTerminal holders: 2,350 (snapshot last updated 2025-04-26). 24h volume mostly on CEXs (CoinGecko tickers 20:08 UTC: MEXC $66.7k, Toobit $42.9k); DEX 24h volume about $3.0k across two pools (DexScreener 22:01 UTC). Supply 900 trillion MIU, all circulating, 0% tax (project Medium).

cats.lore: MIU is a round-faced white kitten who lives in the blue waters of the Sui Network, where the project calls it 'the playful cat bringing fun to Sui'. It has enormous turquoise eyes with droplet-shaped pupils, pink ears, a tiny pink nose and a small wavy smile, and its banner shows it drifting among bubbles, seaweed and little fish. MIU arrived on 3 December 2024, and its community, known as the MIU Army, has kept it swimming ever since, building staking, a token creator and a token lock for fellow Sui users along the way.

cats.name: 施工猫 (Sue the Builder Cat)
cats.catName: Sue (full name Komatsu), the builder kitten of River Reach Construction, Ohio
cats.whoIsTheCat: A real ginger kitten found on 14 July 2026 wedged in the skid plate of a Komatsu excavator by Chase Guello, operating supervisor at River Reach Construction of Barberton, Ohio. About six weeks old and 1.34 lb, she was fostered, named Komatsu ('Sue') by poll, and became the crew's shop cat, living with mechanic Jared. Famous since late July 2026.

virality.summary: Guello filmed the rescue on 14 July 2026: he pulled the skid plate off the excavator and the kitten dropped out 'almost comically' (Akron Beacon Journal). Updates followed, a naming poll made her Komatsu, 'Sue' for short, and on 30 July the crew posted her in a kitten-sized hard hat and hi-vis vest sent by Komatsu. The Akron Beacon Journal, People, Global News and KTLA covered her. On 23 Aug 2026 a two-photo post by @Puppieslover (the hard-hat portrait and Sue with the crew) went viral on X and became a trending story; $SUE was created on Flap the next morning, and its Chinese name 施工猫 means 'construction cat'.
virality.metrics: @Puppieslover post (2026-08-23 19:12 UTC): 40.2M views, 216.2K likes, 21.5K reposts, 2.6K quotes, 19.9K bookmarks (fxtwitter API, read 2026-09-25 21:51 UTC). River Reach's rescue video: 5.8M views (Global News, 27 Aug 2026); the first post had almost 500K likes and ~5,000 comments by 31 July (Akron Beacon Journal). Coin: @Sue_BSC 2,421 followers (joined 2026-08-24); 7,164 holders (flap.sh), 7,190 (GeckoTerminal).

coin.endorsedByOwner: No. The coin's own FAQ says $SUE is not endorsed by, connected to or operated by the construction crew, the photographer, Komatsu Ltd. or the person who first posted about Sue, and no source shows River Reach Construction endorsing it.

cats.lore: One July morning in Ohio, a construction crew heard crying from inside a Komatsu excavator. Supervisor Chase Guello took off the skid plate and a tiny ginger kitten dropped out, about six weeks old and barely over a pound. The crew cooled her down in the office trailer, found her a foster, and let the internet vote on her name: Komatsu, Sue for short. Komatsu sent her a kitten-sized hard hat and hi-vis vest, and now Sue rides between the shop and mechanic Jared's farm home as the crew's official shop cat.
